_method.commit_subject: M18b-1 Part C: the identity is measured before anything consumes it
_method.what: The pipeline at the last commit before M18b-2, run over the six corpora: hunt -> triage -> correlate (ath.hunting.run_hunt, ath.triage.assess_findings, ath.correlation.correlate with set_aside), then ToolBox.process_tree for the reused (device, pid) keys, then the deterministic NullLLM investigation (scripts/m18_cloud_detection.investigate_cases, limit 10) on synthetic and COMISET.
_method.corpora: Each loaded by scripts/m18_cloud_detection.load_corpus, except COMISET, which is read from reports/m18b/canonical -- the M17 freeze predates the identity columns, so measuring this milestone against it would measure a corpus that cannot exercise it.
_method.why_frozen: The investigation numbers cannot be recomputed without the old specialist, so they are recorded here rather than re-derived. The correlation numbers CAN be recomputed: scripts/m18b_identity_consumers.py transcribes the old index, reruns it, and reports agreement with this file on every run.
_method.links: links counted are those inside raised cases, by signal name.
